// The functions of gpu/matrix.mjs, as the working version has them.
// Copied by the course's listing tool. Do not edit.

// region: perspective
// fovY in degrees. A point at distance near lands on z = -w, a point
// at distance far on z = w; w is the distance in front of the eye.
export function perspective(fovY, aspect, near, far) {
  const f = 1 / Math.tan((fovY * Math.PI) / 360);
  const m = new Float64Array(16);
  m[0] = f / aspect;
  m[5] = f;
  m[10] = (far + near) / (near - far);
  m[11] = -1;
  m[14] = (2 * far * near) / (near - far);
  return m;
}
// endregion: perspective

// region: lookAt
// World to camera: the eye moves to the origin, looking down -z.
export function lookAt(eye, target, up) {
  const f = normalize3(sub3(target, eye));
  const s = normalize3(cross3(f, up));
  const u = cross3(s, f);
  const m = identity();
  for (let c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
    m[c * 4 + 0] = s[c];
    m[c * 4 + 1] = u[c];
    m[c * 4 + 2] = -f[c];
  }
  m[12] = -dot3(s, eye);
  m[13] = -dot3(u, eye);
  m[14] = dot3(f, eye);
  return m;
}
// endregion: lookAt
